subject: science
passage: Many lodgepole pines produce cones that are sealed shut with a sticky resin. These cones can stay closed on a tree for years. When the heat of a forest fire finally melts the ______ cones open and drop their seeds onto the freshly burned ground, where young trees can grow in the sunlight.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The third sentence begins with "When," so "When the heat of a forest fire finally melts the resin" is a dependent clause. "The cones open and drop their seeds" is the main clause. A dependent clause that comes first is joined to the main clause with a comma.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A period would leave "When the heat of a forest fire finally melts the resin" as a sentence fragment.
explanation.B: Correct. A comma correctly links the introductory "When" clause to the main clause.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A colon must follow a complete independent clause, and the "When" clause is not one.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A semicolon must join two independent clauses, but the "When" clause is dependent.
